description:
The Newport 4 Drawer Chest has four drawers for sleepers, clothing, and nursery essentials, in a solid Brown Maple frame.

It measures 38 inches wide, 42 inches high, and 18¾ inches deep, and it coordinates with the complete Newport collection.
